headline: Mexican Stocks Snap Six-Session Losing Streak
summary: The S&P/BMV IPC, the main index of the Mexican Stock Exchange, rose 1.6% on Monday, ending a run of six sessions of declines.
why: The S&P/BMV IPC is the benchmark index of the Mexican Stock Exchange, tracking the country's largest listed companies.

impacts.name: S&P/BMV IPC
impacts.why: The benchmark index itself rose 1.6% in the session.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

original_headline: Bolsas mexicanas rompen racha de seis sesiones a la baja
